geo_downloaded.title: Profiling Ileal and Colonic Immune Cell Landscapes in Crohn's Disease and Ulcerative Colitis
geo_downloaded.disease: IBD (Crohn's disease / ulcerative colitis) and healthy controls

matrix.format: sparse triplet CSV with separate row/column name files

geo_downloaded.fit_for_linealinkr: Good for mucosal immune rewiring and blood-versus-tissue communication in inflammatory bowel disease; immune-heavy rather than broad epithelial-stromal ecology.
geo_downloaded.readiness: Annotated raw bundle; convert sparse triplets + metadata to h5ad before direct benchmarking.

geo_downloaded.tissue: colorectal tumor and matched normal tissue

geo_downloaded.fit_for_linealinkr: Strong tumor microenvironment benchmark with explicit tumor/normal labels and hierarchical immune-epithelial-stromal annotations.

geo_downloaded.title: A molecular cell atlas of the human lung from single cell RNA sequencing
geo_downloaded.fit_for_linealinkr: Very strong fibrosis/remodeling benchmark with epithelial, mesenchymal and immune compartments plus disease labels.

geo_downloaded.title: An atlas of human lung single-cell gene expression in fatal COVID-19

matrix.format: per-sample raw count CSVs inside tar archive

geo_downloaded.fit_for_linealinkr: Strong acute injury/inflammation lung benchmark with multiresolution cell types and raw per-sample counts.
geo_downloaded.readiness: Annotated raw bundle; counts are split by sample and need merge/harmonization before direct benchmarking.

overall_assessment: Current curated set is enough for regression tests and developmental smoke benchmarks, but not enough for broad disease-oriented LineaLinkR evaluation. The new GEO additions materially improve lung inflammation/fibrosis, colorectal tumor microenvironment, and inflammatory bowel disease coverage.
